uniform.scope: Analytic 0.5/0.5 expectation from both measured rollouts; no additional random-policy episodes

oracle.scope: Hindsight two-candidate success upper bound and capped-cost lower bound, not a deployable selector

resource_gate.meaning: Resource allocation only, not statistical confirmation. Cost gains cannot rescue a failed success gate.

task_cluster_uncertainty.scope: Descriptive fixed development panel. Task resampling assumes exchangeable task clusters; sign-flip requires independent task effects and null sign symmetry. Tasks share a scene/model and were not randomly sampled; exact enumeration is not a randomized-trial guarantee. No episode-independent or 60-trajectory sample-size inference.
